1. Choose the API you want to use (incidents, or advanced hunting). For more information,
see Supported Microsoft Defender XDR APIs.
2. In the http request you're about to send, set the authorization header to "Bearer"
<token> , Bearer being the authorization scheme, and token being your validated token.
3. The token will expire within one hour. You can send more than one request during this
time with the same token.
The following example shows how to send a request to get a list of incidents using C#.
